facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna lost her parents. She went to live with her aunt. But she always smiled. She played the glad game.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna was a young girl whose parents had passed away. She went to live with her strict Aunt Polly in a big house. Her father had taught her a special game before he died. She played the glad game to find something happy every day. No matter what happened, she looked for the bright side. This simple game changed the way she saw the world.
facts.Word cards: glad = 기쁜 / game = 게임 / played = 했다 / happy = 행복한
